text:
sam_support: Hey team — customer acme-onprem reports their Console shows ZERO tenant metrics for `acme-payments` after the ingress swap around 09:30 UTC. Screenshot: https://go/placeholder/acme-empty.png :frowning:

maria_sre: Which dashboards? just latency or billing counters too?

sam_support: Tenant Overview and Billing dashboards. Queries filter on tenant_id="acme-payments". Other tenants still show data.

devex_june: Heads-up: in Private installs we rely on a header (X-Redwood-Tenant) to tag telemetry. If the ingress rewrote/removed that header metrics ingest won't see tenant labels. Can you attempt a simple curl to echo headers upstream?

sam_support: Ran this from the customer's network to the gateway:

``
curl -sv -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -H "X-Redwood-Tenant: acme-payments" https://inbound.acme.example/internal/echo
```

Response 200 but the upstream service logs show no X-Redwood-Tenant header present.

infra-oncall: Do they run Envoy, nginx, or a custom proxy in front?

alex_prod: They flipped to Envoy earlier this week as part of the ingress rewrite. Envoy route config can remove headers (remove_request_headers). If auth-proxy injected a lowercase header we could be losing it due to canonicalization + removal.

maria_sre: Can you grab the auth-proxy and ingress logs for the 09:25–09:35 window? Also paste the Envoy route snippet if available.

sam_support: Pasted sanitized logs from auth-proxy + ingress:

``
[09:29:01] auth-proxy.INFO request_id=abc123 method=POST path=/v1/infer status=200 upstream=10.2.3.4
[09:29:01] auth-proxy.DEBUG jwt_claims={"sub":"user:123","tenant":"acme-payments"}
[09:29:01] auth-proxy.INFO injected_headers={"X-Forwarded-For":"10.0.0.5","x-rdw-tenant":"acme-payments"}
[09:29:01] ingress.INFO routed to service=runtime-v2 removed_request_headers=["X-Redwood-Tenant"]
```

devex_june: That explains it. Auth-proxy injects `x-rdw-tenant` (lowercase). Envoy route is configured to strip `X-Redwood-Tenant` (exact casing). Our onprem collector still does a strict lookup for `X-Redwood-Tenant`, so when Envoy canonicalizes/removes the header the collector never sees tenant.

maria_sre: Confirmed: legacy collector shim looks up header name case-sensitively. Docs claim header matching is case-insensitive but the shim predates that and uses a direct map lookup.

sam_support: Repro steps I ran for the customer (to share in ticket):
1) curl gateway with X-Redwood-Tenant set
2) observe upstream logs -> header absent
3) check auth-proxy -> it emitted x-rdw-tenant
4) check Envoy route -> remove_request_headers contains X-Redwood-Tenant

infra-oncall: Short-term mitigation: deploy a collector change to accept multiple header names (case variants) so ingestion accepts `x-rdw-tenant` too. That should restore metrics quickly while infra fixes the route.

alex_prod: Working patch for the onprem agent config:

``
- header: "X-Redwood-Tenant"
+ headers: ["X-Redwood-Tenant", "x-rdw-tenant", "x-redwood-tenant"]
```

support-bot: Incident created: INC-2026 - "acme-onprem: tenant metrics missing after ingress rewrite" (severity: medium).

infra-oncall: Hotfix rolled to the customer's collector at 10:14 UTC. Monitoring shows tenant-tagged metrics resuming for acme-payments at ~10:17 UTC. Dashboards repopulating and counters backfilling.

sam_support: Customer confirmed dashboards are back and gave thumbs up. Shared mitigation steps and a note to pin ingress config.

devex_june: Follow-ups: 1) Update Private deployment checklist to call out header passthrough checks after ingress changes. 2) Docs PR to clarify header mapping and collector expectations.

alex_prod: I'll add a Helm chart smoke test that deploys an echo pod and asserts the X-Redwood-Tenant header reaches the runtime; fail the deploy if the header is stripped. Also rolling INF-8273 to revert the route rewrite and add CI guardrails.

sam_support: Marking resolved for now. Will open a short postmortem and link PRs once merged. :white_check_mark:
